resources.name: Elk all-electron full-potential linearized augmented plane wave (FP-LAPW) code

access.notes: Open source (GPL). Any recent version is acceptable.

Lattice parameters a=5.645 Å, c=4.752 Å; space group P6₃mc (No. 186); atomic positions: Ba (2b) (1/3,2/3,z≈0), Co (2a) (0,0,z≈0), O (6c) (x,-x,1/4) with initial x=1/6. Publicly known crystallographic data.
